scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings client/src server/src shared/src tools/sony-contract-bot/src && pnpm run rust:lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @psstore/shared run build && pnpm --filter @psstore/server run typecheck && pnpm --filter @psstore/client run typecheck && pnpm --filter @psstore/sony-contract-bot run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @psstore/shared run test && pnpm --filter @psstore/server run test && pnpm --filter @psstore/client run test && pnpm --filter @psstore/sony-contract-bot run test && pnpm run rust:test
scripts.test-all: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run scan:secrets && pnpm run scan:deps && pnpm run build && pnpm run test && pnpm run sony:validate && pnpm run sony:diff -- --ci
scripts.scan:deps: pnpm audit --audit-level low && pnpm run rust:scan
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm --filter @psstore/shared run build && pnpm --filter @psstore/client run build && pnpm --filter @psstore/server run build && pnpm --filter @psstore/sony-contract-bot run build && pnpm run rust:build
scripts.clean: rm -rf build client/build server/dist shared/dist tools/sony-contract-bot/dist
scripts.rust:scan: cargo deny --locked check bans licenses sources && cargo audit --deny warnings
